title: Jim Semivan's 7-hour briefing at the CIA
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Jim Semivan's 7-hour briefing at the CIA, about undated at CIA headquarters, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the 7-hour briefing. They tell him, these high level guys tell him, "Get a room in the CIA for 6 to8 hours.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells of Jim Semivan, a man who worked at the CIA, the US spy agency, being given a very long briefing there. According to Cameron, high-level people told Semivan to book a room at the CIA for six to eight hours, and the session became known as the 7-hour briefing. The story suggests senior insiders had a great deal to tell about the subject.
